metadata.title: RFQ/HCR/PZU/2026/27 — hydraulic control valves and PED manifolds

text: United Nations Global Marketplace contract notice. Request for quotation RFQ/HCR/PZU/2026/27 for the supply of corrosion-resistant hydraulic control valves, PED-certified manifolds and ATEX process fittings for a field office in the Gulf. Pre-qualification requires ISO 9001 and PED. Country of delivery: United Arab Emirates. This is an invitation to tender / request for quotation, not a directory listing.

metadata.title: PETRONAS breaks ground on Pengerang downstream capacity expansion

text: Kuala Lumpur / Pengerang — PETRONAS announced a brownfield plant expansion and new manufacturing trains at the Pengerang downstream complex. Capex covers heat-exchanger cores, process fabrication and commissioning of additional production lines. Industrial development in Malaysia is expected to increase component sourcing from European precision vendors during 2026-2027.

metadata.title: Form 20-F supply-chain disclosure — active component sourcing

text: The registrant’s Form 20-F includes a supply chain disclosure describing active component sourcing of industrial sensors, ATEX transmitters and actuators from qualified overseas manufacturers. Customs filing and authorized economic operator status are cited. Trade filing language indicates ongoing import of precision instrumentation into Singapore and Qatar.
